title: Find the best start time for your ride
metaTitle: Best start time for your bike ride – {name}
description: The wind turns during the day. {name} checks your route against every start time in your window and recommends when to leave – for tailwind, dry roads or both.
intro: The same loop can feel completely different at 7 am and at noon. {name} checks your route against every start time in your window and tells you when to leave – so the wind helps on the way home, not on the way out.

how.title: Every start time, one route
how.text: Pick the window you could start in. {name} runs your route through the forecast for each start time – with the arrival time at every point.

how.title: Tailwind, dry or balanced
how.text: Choose what matters today: maximum tailwind, a balance of wind and rain, or the driest ride. The recommendation follows your choice.

how.title: See what you gain
how.text: Compare the recommended start with your planned one – Tailwind Score and Wind Cost show what the earlier or later start is worth in minutes.
